name: Platform API
summary: The NestJS control plane of Velexis: accounts, OTAs (tenants), billing, connections, domains, API keys and admin operations, plus a worker for queues and schedules.
audience: OTA worker and OTA API (queues, Redis, read-only tables)

local.notes: Starts the API (127.0.0.1:3100) and the worker (health on 127.0.0.1:3101). Needs PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Mailpit (http://127.0.0.1:8025) and the Amadeus stub (pnpm stub:amadeus); run pnpm dev:keys, pnpm db:migrate, pnpm db:seed:reference and dev:seed first; run the OTA worker for provisioning.

talksTo.how: Answers the portal server's REST calls on loopback (Bearer portal token, PADR-0019 BFF headers)
Answers the admin server's REST calls on loopback (Bearer admin token)
BullMQ ota-tenant-ops (out) and platform-tenant-events (in); Redis vx:invalidate, ptk:, staffdeny:, apikey:used:; the OTA role reads selected platform tables
Caddy proxies api.platform.example.com, forwards /webhooks/stripe/* and calls GET /internal/tls/ask; systemd units velexis-platform-api and velexis-platform-worker
Uses @velexis/db, api-types, errors, config, crypto, logger, testing

data: Redis: ptk:, staffdeny:acct:, apikey:used:, vx:idem:, vx:stripe:sub:, mfach:, mfasetup:, mfastep:, stripe:oauth:, tlsask:, rl:
BullMQ queues ota-tenant-ops, platform-tenant-events, platform-emails, platform-stripe-events, platform-domains, platform-connections, platform-settlements, platform-maintenance

roles.name: OTA owner
roles.can: Everything on its OTA: profile, keys, domains, connections and credentials (step-up), team incl. owners/admins, billing, payout account (step-up), go-live (step-up), retry setup, reveal initial keys

roles.name: OTA admin (tenant role)
roles.can: Profile, API keys, domains, connections, invite/manage agent, finance and viewer members; no billing, payout or go-live

roles.name: Finance member
roles.can: See overview, connections (masked), subscription, invoices, settlements and payout account (masked)

roles.name: Agent / viewer
roles.can: See the overview and onboarding, list members, open the console, leave the OTA

roles.name: Platform admin
roles.can: Every /v1/admin/** operation (MFA mandatory; step-up for Amadeus credentials, settlement approve/pay, payout reveal, MFA reset, admin grant/revoke); changes, sign-ins and sensitive reads audited

roles.name: Signed-in, unverified account
roles.can: Only portal_unverified operations: getMe, updateMe, MFA set-up, sessions, sign-out, listTenants

roles.name: Anonymous
roles.can: Public operations: sign-up, verify, resend verification, sign-in, MFA verify, refresh, password reset, listPlans, invitation lookup, admin sign-in/MFA/refresh, health/live
